item: Row D on real extracts: notable-first search, disk worst case, paged index build
summary: Real Liechtenstein and a 16x real-data composite in a 3.5 GiB envelope found a rank-only search burying the capital, a disk floor 4x under the worst case, a search-index build and kept-id sets whose memory grew with the country (peak 2213 to 823 MB); fixed, with the open list recorded.
